title: OpenField Studio: the hero loop
_comment: The README's first image: the wall playing the dolly-in, then the footage following the move. Record on the hosted Replay at 1280x720 and turn it into a GIF: python scripts/record_demo.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8080/ --out data-dev/hero --width 1280 --height 720 --fps 12, then ffmpeg -i data-dev/hero/demo.mp4 -vf "fps=12,scale=1200:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=192[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5" docs/media/hero.gif
